method.commons: Wikimedia Commons search per site name, filtered to equirectangular signature (width >= 3000px, aspect 1.9-2.1), then distance-scored against the site coordinate where the file carries GPS metadata.
method.streetView: Not run — no Maps Platform key configured.

conclusion: No licensed 360° panorama depicting any catalogued Sikkim monastery was found. Every site therefore reports no 360° experience. This is a real negative result, not an unfinished search.

streetView.reason: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY not configured. The Street View metadata endpoint is the only sanctioned availability check; scraping the Maps site instead would breach its terms.
